title: API Mutual and Token-Based Authentication
text_template: The {asset} shall enforce mutual TLS authentication for server-to-server channels and OAuth 2.0 token validation with maximum 15-minute expiry for client-facing endpoints.

title: Firmware Digital Signature Verification
text_template: The {asset} shall verify the digital signature of every firmware image using ECDSA P-256 or Ed25519 before installation, and shall reject any image with an invalid or absent signature.

title: Secure Boot Chain Implementation
text_template: The {asset} shall implement a hardware-rooted secure boot chain that verifies the integrity of each boot stage from ROM bootloader through application firmware.

title: In-Vehicle Message Authentication
text_template: The {asset} shall apply cryptographic message authentication codes (CMAC-AES-128 minimum) to all safety-critical CAN and Automotive Ethernet frames.

title: Message Replay Protection
text_template: The {asset} shall include monotonic freshness values (counters or timestamps) in all authenticated messages and shall reject any message with a stale or reused freshness value.

title: In-Vehicle Network Intrusion Detection
text_template: The {asset} shall deploy an anomaly-based intrusion detection system that monitors CAN/Ethernet frame frequency, timing, and payload patterns and raises alerts within 500 ms of anomaly detection.

title: Cryptographic Key Protection in HSM
text_template: The {asset} shall store all cryptographic keys in a tamper-resistant Hardware Security Module (HSM) that prevents key extraction and performs all cryptographic operations internally.

title: Diagnostic Service Access Control
text_template: The {asset} shall enforce role-based access control on all diagnostic services, requiring authentication appropriate to the requested service level before granting access.

title: Security Event Logging
text_template: The {asset} shall log all security-relevant events with tamper-evident timestamps, including authentication attempts, access control decisions, configuration changes, and detected anomalies.

title: Network Domain Segmentation
text_template: The {asset} shall segment the in-vehicle network into isolated security domains and enforce allowlist-based firewall rules permitting only explicitly authorized message flows between domains.

title: OTA Package Integrity Validation
text_template: The {asset} shall verify the integrity of every OTA update package against a cryptographic hash (SHA-256) in the signed manifest before and after download, rejecting packages with mismatched hashes.

title: API Rate Limiting Enforcement
text_template: The {asset} shall enforce per-client and per-endpoint rate limits, applying graduated throttling and blocking clients that exceed defined request thresholds.

title: Input Validation at Trust Boundaries
text_template: The {asset} shall validate and sanitize all external inputs at trust boundary entry points against defined schemas, rejecting malformed or out-of-range values before processing.

title: Communication Channel Encryption
text_template: The {asset} shall encrypt all data in transit using TLS 1.3 (or DTLS 1.2+ for UDP) with approved cipher suites and shall disable all legacy protocols and weak ciphers.

title: Certificate Validation and Pinning
text_template: The {asset} shall pin expected server certificate public keys and validate the full certificate chain, rejecting connections to servers presenting unknown or revoked certificates.

title: Firmware Anti-Rollback Protection
text_template: The {asset} shall maintain a monotonic firmware version counter in secure storage and shall reject any firmware update whose version is less than or equal to the stored counter value.

title: Supply-Chain Component Security Verification
text_template: The {asset} shall require all third-party component suppliers to provide an SBOM, pass security audits, and demonstrate compliance with cybersecurity development lifecycle requirements.

title: Bluetooth Secure Pairing Enforcement
text_template: The {asset} shall enforce Bluetooth Secure Simple Pairing with Numeric Comparison or Passkey Entry, disable legacy and Just Works pairing, and require explicit user confirmation for new pairings.

title: Application Integrity Protection
text_template: The {asset} shall verify the code-signing signature of all application packages at install time and shall implement runtime integrity checks including root/jailbreak detection.

title: Data Minimization and Consent Management
text_template: The {asset} shall collect only the minimum data required for each stated purpose, enforce configurable retention limits, and provide user consent management for all personal data collection.

title: Time Synchronization Authentication
text_template: The {asset} shall authenticate all time synchronization traffic using NTS or symmetric key authentication and shall reject time updates that deviate from the local monotonic clock by more than a configurable threshold.

title: Security Event Alert Generation
text_template: The {asset} shall generate alerts and escalation notifications when security event counts, IDS scores, or authentication failure rates exceed configurable thresholds within a defined time window.

title: Firmware Confidentiality at Rest
text_template: The {asset} shall encrypt firmware images stored on flash memory and on distribution servers using AES-256, with decryption keys accessible only through the HSM during verified boot.

title: Diagnostic Session Timeout and Lockout
text_template: The {asset} shall terminate diagnostic sessions after 30 seconds of inactivity and shall implement exponential backoff lockout after three consecutive failed security-access attempts.

title: CAN Message Rate Filtering
text_template: The {asset} shall enforce per-arbitration-ID message rate limits and shall drop frames exceeding expected transmission rates to prevent bus-flooding denial-of-service attacks.

title: Telemetry Anomaly Detection
text_template: The {asset} shall apply statistical and rule-based anomaly detection to telemetry data streams, flagging data points that deviate from expected ranges or patterns for security review.

title: Administrative Multi-Factor Authentication
text_template: The {asset} shall require multi-factor authentication (password plus hardware token or TOTP) for all administrative access and shall enforce session re-authentication for sensitive operations.

title: Key Lifecycle Management
text_template: The {asset} shall support automated key provisioning during manufacturing, periodic key rotation on a configurable schedule, and immediate fleet-wide revocation of compromised keys.

title: Incident Response Capability
text_template: The {asset} shall support documented incident response procedures covering detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, including remote vehicle remediation capability.

title: OBD-II Port Physical Security
text_template: The {asset} shall implement physical countermeasures for the OBD-II port including tamper-evident covers, and shall generate alerts when unknown devices are connected.

title: Log Integrity via Hash Chains
text_template: The {asset} shall protect the integrity of all security and audit logs using cryptographic hash chains, with chain anchor values stored in the HSM to enable tampering detection.
